title: GET|PUT /api/v1/verify/cloud-rm
description: The tenant's rm:mark1-rm-a@1 register row (m1_073, 16 §L6): whether the cloud reward model may score the E1 task text and sanitized hunks of devices that chose Cloud (m1_097 cloud_rm) on Baseten, US region, zero data retention. Absence is the default (enabled=false with the static disclosure); PUT enabled=true writes the row, PUT enabled=false revokes it. judge_id is the m1_065 register key column.
